$schema: Config-driven layer + dataset definitions. The app builds its layer panel, legends, deck.gl layers, and inspector context rows from this file. Adding a rendered layer = new entry in `layers[]` with a matching adapter and (if applicable) sample file. Adding a non-rendered data source that feeds the inspector = new entry in `datasets[]`. See 03_DATA_CATALOG.md for full source detail and 04_SAMPLE_SCHEMAS.md for field-level schemas.

renderTypes.point: deck.gl ScatterplotLayer or IconLayer; one feature per pin
renderTypes.polygon: deck.gl GeoJsonLayer with fill and stroke
renderTypes.choropleth: deck.gl GeoJsonLayer with fill driven by a data field, scaled by a legend ramp
renderTypes.isochrone: deck.gl GeoJsonLayer for the polygon plus a stored population-within value

layers.label: School locations
layers.legendCaption: Colored and labeled by current letter grade
layers.source: FL DOE Master School ID + NCES EDGE geocodes
layers.notes: Rooftop-accurate points. Grade drives pin color and pin letter. Encoding is color + letter, never color alone. See 05_ACCURACY_STANDARDS.md section 3.

layers.label: Median household income
layers.resolution: tract (display) / block group (available at high zoom)
layers.notes: Prefer tract for displayed values (inspector). Block-group MOE is high. Choropleth fill only, no labels on polygons.

layers.label: School board member districts
layers.source: County GIS / Supervisor of Elections (three separate county sources)
layers.notes: Three separate county sources means three per-county adapters, not one. See 03_DATA_CATALOG.md and 06_ARCHITECTURE.md.

layers.label: FEMA flood zones
layers.notes: AE, VE, and floodway are the high-risk zones and the ones most relevant to school siting. Coastal Miami-Dade and Broward carry the most exposure.

layers.label: Drive-time reach (15 min)
layers.legendCaption: OSM road network via OpenRouteService or Valhalla
layers.source: OpenStreetMap via OpenRouteService (demo) or self-hosted Valhalla (production)
layers.notes: Isochrones are ground-truth (real road network). Intersect with ACS school-age population (area-weighted) for the reach count. Precompute and cache. Free-tier ORS is insufficient at scale, see 03_DATA_CATALOG.md.

layers.label: Population growth
layers.source: U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program (Vintage 2024) + ACS 2019-2023
layers.notes: County-level and coarse. Toggle is present but disabled with 'sample not yet included' tooltip until sample ships or real data wires in.

layers.label: Opportunity zones
layers.source: HUD Opportunity Zones (Treasury/IRS designated QOZ tracts)
layers.vintage: 2018 designations (in effect through 12/31/2028); swap when 2027 OBBBA refresh publishes
layers.notes: Small, mostly-static layer. Quick to add once verified. Verify 2018 vs 2027 designation status before shipping.

layers.label: Legislative districts
layers.notes: Boundaries are free and easy. Representative names are a separate dataset (see datasets[]).

layers.label: Parcels (optional)
layers.notes: Miami-Dade alone has ~800k parcels; this cannot be a committed GeoJSON. Requires PostGIS + vector tiles from day one. High minZoom prevents accidentally loading it at county view.

datasets.label: Historic grades
datasets.notes: Not a map layer; consumed by SchoolInspector > GradeTimeline. Formula-change years marked at 2009-2010, 2011-2012, 2014-2015, 2021-2022. Never draw a continuous trend line across breaks.

datasets.label: Current representatives
datasets.purpose: Populates member_name in board_districts and legislative_districts inspector rows
datasets.source: unitedstates/congress-legislators (federal, populated); OpenStates + county board rosters (state/board, pending)
datasets.vintage: Current U.S. House + Senate for Florida
datasets.notes: Federal U.S. House members (by district overlapping a pilot county) and both FL U.S. Senators are populated from congress-legislators. State-legislative and county school-board member NAMES are carried as empty tables, not guessed: populate from OpenStates and each county's board/SOE roster after each election. Boundaries for all chambers are already real in the legislative_districts layer.

datasets.label: Enrollment history
datasets.source: NCES Common Core of Data via Urban Institute Education Data Portal
datasets.notes: Real annual PK-12 membership (all grades) keyed by MSID. Enriches the inspector Performance section with an enrollment trend. Not a rendered layer.
